verdict.rationale: Secureframe's Trust Center is documented as a live, admin-configurable hub (publish, hide/display content, document requests/NDA) fed by continuous daily control monitoring and automated evidence collection, and vendor risk management continuously monitors vendors and detects shadow IT to keep vendor lists current — all suggesting the platform, not manual work, drives status updates. However, there is no explicit evidence tying subprocessor-list updates or document-renewal tracking specifically to the Trust Center's auto-refresh, so the story's exact scope isn't fully confirmed.  missing for 10: explicit documentation that subprocessor lists on the Trust Center auto-sync from vendor data, and that document expirations/renewals trigger automatic Trust Center updates.
